name: New Jersey Appellate Division
court: Superior Court of New Jersey, Appellate Division
source_note: Rule numbers and day counts are a deadline table, not legal advice. Confirm the current New Jersey Court Rules before relying on a date. This pack never files or serves.

deadlines.label: Motion for reconsideration in the Appellate Division
deadlines.notes: Within 10 days of the date of entry of the judgment or order. The time may be enlarged under R. 1:3-4(a).

deadlines.label: Motion in the appellate court
deadlines.notes: Governs form and service of motions in the Appellate Division. Use the deadline that belongs to the relief requested.

deadlines.label: Motion to alter or amend a trial-court judgment
deadlines.notes: Not later than 20 days after service of the judgment. Trial-level clock.

deadlines.label: Enlargement of time
deadlines.notes: The court may enlarge the time for taking action except where a rule says the time may not be enlarged.

deadlines.label: Stay pending appeal (motion)
deadlines.notes: Stay practice is motion-driven. Confirm the current rule text before using a date.

deadlines.label: Tolling of time to appeal
deadlines.notes: A timely motion of the listed kinds tolls the time for appeal until entry of the order deciding the motion. Confirm the current list of tolling motions.

forms.title: Motion for reconsideration (Appellate Division)
forms.court: Superior Court of New Jersey, Appellate Division

teach.what_it_is: A written request that the Appellate Division look again at an order or judgment it already entered. OpenSeason can format the motion packet. It does not file it.
teach.when_used: When an Appellate Division judgment or order was just entered and you want that same court to reconsider it. The bundled deadline table counts 10 days from entry under R. 2:11-6.
common_mistakes: Counting from the day you received the order instead of the date of entry.
Treating this as a new appeal instead of a motion in the same court.
Inventing case citations to fill the brief. Use only authorities you already have.
teach.learn_more: Confirm the current text of R. 2:11-6 on the New Jersey Courts rules page before relying on the day count. Time may be enlarged under R. 1:3-4(a). A timely motion of this kind may toll the time to appeal under R. 2:4-3(e).

forms.title: Motion for enlargement of time
forms.court: Superior Court of New Jersey, Appellate Division

teach.what_it_is: A request that the court give you more time to take a step the rules already allow. You write why you need the time. The app only formats the paper.
teach.when_used: When a clock is running and the rule that governs your step can be enlarged. Some times cannot be enlarged; the pack does not list every exception.
common_mistakes: Assuming every deadline can be extended.
Waiting until after a non-enlargeable time has already run.
teach.learn_more: R. 1:3-4(a) says the court may enlarge time except where a rule says it may not. Read the rule that created your deadline.

forms.title: Motion for a stay pending appeal
forms.court: Superior Court of New Jersey, Appellate Division

teach.what_it_is: A request to pause enforcement of an order while an appeal is pending. Stay practice is motion-driven in this pack.
teach.when_used: When an order will take effect and you have asked (or will ask) a higher court to review it. This pack does not pick a day count.
common_mistakes: Treating a stay motion as an automatic pause. It is not automatic in this pack.
Inventing bond or security terms. Write only terms you actually propose.
teach.learn_more: Confirm the current text of R. 2:9-5. The app will not file or serve the motion.

forms.title: How to Appeal a Trial Court Decision (pro se appellate kit)
forms.court: Superior Court of New Jersey, Appellate Division

teach.what_it_is: The New Jersey Judiciary's published pro se kit on how to appeal a trial-court decision. JustLegal catalogued it as CN 10837. OpenSeason does not bundle the PDF.
teach.when_used: When a trial court entered a final decision and you are considering an appeal to the Appellate Division.
common_mistakes: Missing the notice-of-appeal deadline. This pack does not state that day count; confirm the current rule.
Using a fixture or draft instead of the court's own kit.
teach.learn_more: Download from njcourts.gov or install an NJ forms pack. The JustLegal mirror hash is recorded in the public registry; re-verify the file before you rely on it.

situations.label: I lost and want the same court to look again
situations.question: Did the Appellate Division just enter an order you want that same court to reconsider?
situations.court: Superior Court of New Jersey, Appellate Division
situations.why: The bundled NJ pack treats this as a motion for reconsideration under R. 2:11-6, not as a new appeal.

steps.title: Count the reconsideration clock
steps.why: The pack counts 10 calendar days from entry, then rolls weekends and New Jersey holidays to the next business day.

teach.what_it_is: A deadline table, not a court order. You still confirm the date of entry from the papers you have.
teach.when_used: As soon as you have the date the order was entered.
common_mistakes: Using the date you opened the mail instead of the date of entry.
teach.learn_more: Time may be enlarged under R. 1:3-4(a). A timely motion may toll the appeal clock under R. 2:4-3(e).

steps.title: Write the motion packet in your own words
steps.why: Notice of motion, motion, certification, proposed order, and certificate of service. You write the grounds. The app formats.

teach.what_it_is: The five-part packet OpenSeason can assemble from your draft.
teach.when_used: After you have the order and your own grounds.
common_mistakes: Letting an agent invent facts or case citations to fill blank sections.
teach.learn_more: Use draft sections / draft fill. Leave a box blank rather than guessing.

situations.label: I need more time
situations.question: Is a clock running, and do you want the court to give you more time?
situations.court: Superior Court of New Jersey, Appellate Division
situations.why: The pack points at R. 1:3-4(a). Some times cannot be enlarged. This app will not decide that for you.

steps.title: Write why you need the time
steps.why: The court reads your reasons, not a template paragraph.

teach.what_it_is: A motion asking the court to enlarge time.
teach.when_used: Before a enlargeable deadline runs, if you need more time.
common_mistakes: Assuming every deadline can be extended.
teach.learn_more: Read the rule that created your original deadline.

situations.label: I need the order paused
situations.question: Will an order take effect while you are asking a higher court to review it?
situations.court: Superior Court of New Jersey, Appellate Division
situations.why: The pack cites R. 2:9-5. Stay practice is motion-driven. There is no automatic day count in this pack.

steps.title: Write the stay terms you actually want
steps.why: The app will not invent bond, security, or who is restrained.

teach.what_it_is: A motion to pause enforcement pending appeal.
teach.when_used: When enforcement would happen before the appeal is decided.
teach.learn_more: Confirm the current text of R. 2:9-5.

situations.label: I am appealing a trial-court decision

situations.court: Superior Court of New Jersey, Appellate Division
